summary: Read all 61 changed/added files of this unit. FloatSpec is a Lean port of the Coq Flocq/Pff floating-point libraries: Core/, Calc/, IEEE754/, Pff/, Prop/, ErrorBound/, and Test/ hold real definitions, theorems, and regression examples translated from the Coq sources (spot-checked FloatSpec/Test/BracketSource.lean, FloatSpec/Test/PrimFloatSource.lean, FloatSpec/src/Core/RauxSourceFacade.lean, and FloatSpec/src/IEEE754/SourceCorrectnessAliases.lean, all of which contain theorem/def/example declarations or alias re-exports with real math content). Nine files in the unit have no theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom keyword; eight of these (FloatSpec/Test.lean, FloatSpec/VersoExt.lean, FloatSpec/src.lean, FloatSpec/src/Core.lean, FloatSpec/src/IEEE754.lean, FloatSpec/src/IEEE754/SourceCorrectnessAliases.lean [has alias, not import-only], FloatSpec/src/Pff.lean, FloatSpec/src/Prop.lean) are pure import aggregators or an alias/comment file, which FILTER-007 keeps out of the unilateral hard-exclusion class absent verified end-to-end deployment of an auxiliary navigation channel, so they are retained. The ninth, lakefile.lean, is the Lake package manifest: its full content is `import Lake`, `open Lake DSL`, and `package`/`lean_lib`/`lean_exe`/`require` build-target declarations with leanOptions and dependency pins -- a format-aware check (Lake DSL commands only, zero theorem/lemma/def/structure/proof content) establishes it holds no formal mathematical declarations, matching FILTER-004(1); it is excluded, consistent with the 'build' category the prior review of this source (RRV-0928b0fae78c-r1) already established as excludable alongside linter/documentation-stub/placeholder-entrypoint files. All other 60 files stay searchable.
